description.value: The Shawnigan Lake Community Centre is a CVRD-operated public facility serving the Shawnigan Lake area of the Cowichan Valley on southern Vancouver Island. It sits at the edge of the Shawnigan Lake community, a popular destination for cyclists riding the Cowichan Valley region. As a regional district community centre, it likely serves as a gathering hub for local recreation and events.
